content:
deploybot: starting canary rollout for release v4.2.1 -> 5% traffic us-west1 (hosted + dedicated). conditions: canary window 15m.
Ingrid P: noticing a small uptick in embedding P99 latency on canary; +120ms over baseline.
Ravi K: dedicated pool logs show a few OOMs on pC nodes around 3991230030, repeated in two hosts.
sre-bot: alert: dedicated-pool-gpu-oom x3 from node p-c-12, stack traces attached (s3://redwood/logs/3991230001/oom). :warning:
Sophia L: are these customers on reserved capacity? Could be quantization edge-case with v4.2.1.
Ravi K: yes, two reserved customers hit errors; inbound error rate +3% and retries flooding the queue.
Ops Lead: deploybot, can we pause further rollouts and pin affected dedicated pools to v4.2.0 for safety?
deploybot: pausing canary progression per request. Autoscale remains enabled. No auto-rollback was triggered (threshold not met for hosted). :white_check_mark:
Ingrid P: command to pin: ```redwood-cli pools pin --pool dedicated-usw2 --model redwood-v4.2.0 --note "rollback for OOMs"``` — run with ops approval
Ops Lead: Ravi/Ingrid, can one of you run the pin and post the confirmation? I'll notify CS/Marketing.
Ravi K: running pin now. will also drain new sessions on p-c-12. ```redwood-cli pools pin --pool dedicated-usw2 --model redwood-v4.2.0 --force``` 
Ravi K: pinned. confirmation id: pin-399123-7. Drained p-c-12, routing reverted to 4.2.0 for pool. :thumbsup:
Customer Success KP: notifying affected accounts now with short blurb. Draft: "We've temporarily pinned your dedicated pool to v4.2.0 while we investigate an OOM regression in v4.2.1. No data was lost; we'll follow up with timeline." OK?
Marketing Sam: will update release notes and stop the release banner. I'll add postmortem placeholder.
Sophia L: next steps: repro on CI with same quantization flags, run model memory profiler, and coordinate rollback if hosted shows same pattern within 30m.
Ingrid P: agree. setting a 30m watch window. If hosted error rate or p99 regression crosses thresholds, we'll trigger full rollback.
Ops Lead: thanks everyone. logging incident and tagging oncall. reopening if we need to roll back hosted. closing thread unless new signals surface.
